question:
Identify the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) and logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/816c002aaafd2b7635663edc8eb4d1f206ac840108e14c5d2cdc37f4b60682ab.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) For the square element → One line is eliminated in each box subsequently.

2) For the Rhombus element → One rhombus is added in each box subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2d2e9b8e34c3dded27188b76ce93cd2773ab6125c905b1accbe64e37b9f546c.png] 

 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c76cb24153c82dede873bdf1f8353a464bed739b53b85877140a04ffc4eb0f9.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
